trust_center.repositoryDescription: Pryme Infil Trust Center — security and compliance documentation for agencies evaluating the offering.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Visit the Trust Center and select the document you wish to review. You will be presented with a request form; submit it to request access. Pryme Infil reviews each request and grants access to the requested documents once approved.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: Secure Configuration Guide for agency administrators — how to securely access, configure, operate, and decommission privileged accounts, and the security implication of each administrative setting.
secure_configuration_guidance.accessRequestInstructions: Access the guide through the Pryme Infil Trust Center: select the document and submit the request form. Pryme Infil reviews each request and grants access once approved.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Tactical operation and event planning (SMEAC, course of action, breach and energetic-breach plans, contingencies, deconfliction, control points, briefings, negotiations), structured risk assessment, real-time operational messaging and channels, live and historical GPS mapping of personnel and assets, and in-app, email, and push notifications.
After-action reports, use-of-force and injury reporting, property damage, medical aid, and evidentiary finds.
Training events, training matrices, qualification tracking and compliance results, and K9 program management (certifications, health records, deployments, training logs).

Teams, rosters, personnel and applicant profiles, emergency contacts, personas and permissions, and inventory and assignment of equipment and assets (drones, chemical agents, body-worn cameras, firearms, less-lethal weapons, radios, vehicles, GPS devices).

Upload, storage, and organization of operational documents, images, and media in per-tenant encrypted storage; custom form templates, captured form data, and agency-configurable data dictionary fields.
Configurable dashboards and widgets with an analytics layer over tenant operational data.

current.service_desc: Cloud-based command-and-control platform for public safety operations, providing operational planning, real-time team coordination, encrypted messaging, GPS mapping, risk assessments, and after-action documentation for law enforcement and public safety agencies.
